annotations.title: Edit the scenes of a video

description: [Free] Edits a video's storyboard in 22 operations, each described on its branch: words, captions, visuals (incl. "rushie" designed cards: data.rushie {template, props}), data, shots, scenes, transitions, fx, presenter, voice, music, look. Does not re-render — rerender_video makes the new film. Every call is snapshotted, so an edit can be undone (list_revisions).

operations.description: The changes, in order, up to 20; all are validated before any is written, so a bad batch changes nothing. A wrong figure is set_data plus one rerender_video, not a new video.

oneOf.description: Replace what a scene says. The film is as long as its voiceover, so this changes the length.

narration.description: The new words; [pause 500ms] = silence. Empty: a silent scene (trim_scene sets its hold).

scene_id.description: The scene to rewrite. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: rewrite_narration

oneOf.description: Set or clear the on-screen caption of a scene.

caption.description: The new caption, or null to remove it.

scene_id.description: The scene to caption. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_caption

oneOf.description: Rename a scene (the editor's label, never shown in the film).

heading.description: The new heading, as get_storyboard reports it.

scene_id.description: The scene to rename. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_heading

oneOf.description: How long a SILENT scene holds; a narrated one is refused (narrated_scene).

duration_seconds.description: Seconds held; list_motions gives each animation's minimum.

scene_id.description: The scene to trim. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: trim_scene

oneOf.description: Tint a scene: problem = red vignette and shake, win = warm glow.

mood.description: "problem" for a hook, "win" for a payoff, "neutral" clears it.

scene_id.description: The scene to tint. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_mood

oneOf.description: URL videos only: a screen recording of one element, optionally on another page of the site. The best shot acts — click the call to action, or type a real query. The selector is checked live; if several match, the first is filmed (the result says so).

action.description: click: pressed, the page answers (most persuasive). type: types `text`, never Enter. hover, spotlight (frames it), hero (its section), scroll.

page_url.description: Another page of the SAME site. Omitted: the video's own page.

scene_id.description: The scene to re-film; a drawn scene becomes a recording. Id from get_storyboard.

selector.description: An inspect_page candidate's selector, byte for byte. Matching nothing is refused with the nearest real ones.

text.description: For action type: a real query a visitor would type, never personal data.

oneOf.title: set_shot

oneOf.description: Delete a scene. A storyboard must keep at least one.

scene_id.description: The scene to delete. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: remove_scene

oneOf.description: Insert a scene. A visual needs its fields in `data` (list_motions). Without one it records the video's page (URL videos only), aimed with selector.

after_scene_id.description: Insert after this scene. No anchor: append.

before_scene_id.description: Insert before this scene (how to insert first).

caption.description: The lower-third text drawn over the scene.

data.description: The visual's payload; list_motions names the fields each visual needs.

duration_seconds.description: How long a SILENT scene holds.

heading.description: The editor's label for the new scene.

motion.description: The entrance animation, from the visual's family (list_motions).

narration.description: What the voice says; it sets the length. Empty: silent, held for duration_seconds.

selector.description: For a recorded scene (no visual): aim the camera now, as set_shot's selector.

shot_text.description: As set_shot's text, for shot_action type.

visual.description: As set_visual's visual. Omitted: a recording of the page.

oneOf.title: add_scene

oneOf.description: Copy a scene after itself, media included (nothing re-made).

scene_id.description: The scene to copy. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: duplicate_scene

oneOf.description: Insert a saved scene (list_scenes) with its media, no AI cost; params fills its {{placeholders}}.

params.description: Values for its {{placeholders}}, e.g. {"price": "49 €"}; fill every one.

scene.description: The library scene's name or id, from list_scenes.

oneOf.title: add_scene_from_library

oneOf.description: Put the scenes in a new order, listing each exactly once.

scene_ids.description: Every scene id of the video, in the order you want them.

oneOf.title: reorder_scenes

oneOf.description: Change how a scene is drawn. Its content is carried over unless you send new data.

data.description: The visual's payload — the same shape get_storyboard returns. Omit it to keep what the scene already carries.

scene_id.description: The scene to redraw. Id from get_storyboard.

visual.description: The visual to draw it as.

oneOf.title: set_visual

oneOf.description: How a DRAWN scene arrives (set_motion animates its contents); never changes the length. list_motions describes each.

duration_ms.description: How long the arrival takes; capped at a third of the scene.

scene_id.description: The scene to change the arrival of. Id from get_storyboard.

transition.description: "cut" is a hard cut, no effect — the right answer more often than not.

oneOf.title: set_transition

oneOf.description: A drawn scene's face and colours: replaces its style ({} = the film's).

scene_id.description: The scene to restyle. Id from get_storyboard.

style.description: As create_animation's scene style, minus transition.

oneOf.title: set_style

oneOf.description: Change a scene's entrance animation (and fx); the wrong family is refused.

motion.description: From list_motions, in the visual's family.

scene_id.description: The scene to re-animate. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_motion

oneOf.description: A presenter in the corner: a generated clip of a person OVER this scene. Paid plans; one clip, refunded if it fails. generate: null removes it.

character.description: A create_character name, so the same face recurs.

corner.description: Omitted: the corner clear of the subject. Named: honoured, even over it.

generate.description: The shot, e.g. "a woman at a desk, talking to camera"; a quoted line is said aloud.

model.description: As generate_asset's model (auto, a list_models id, omit: house).

mute.description: The face without the voice (default: heard only on a silent scene).

objects.description: Object names (list_objects) the presenter shows, kept consistent.

scene_id.description: The scene to put a presenter on. Id from get_storyboard.

shape.description: rounded keeps the clip; circle crops to a head (needs a close-up).

size.description: Width as a share of the frame; clamped, never refused.

oneOf.title: set_inset

oneOf.description: Correct a scene's content, keeping visual and motion. Send the WHOLE payload (it replaces): get_storyboard's `data`, fixed.

data.description: The visual's payload, as get_storyboard returns it.

scene_id.description: The scene to correct. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_data

oneOf.description: Change the narrator for the whole video.

voice.description: The whole video's narrator (set_scene_voice for one scene).

oneOf.title: set_voice

oneOf.description: One scene's own narrator, pace or register; none of the three restores the film's.

scene_id.description: The scene to direct. Id from get_storyboard.

oneOf.title: set_scene_voice

oneOf.description: Replace the voice's lexicon (captions keep the text); [] clears it.
oneOf.title: set_pronunciations

oneOf.description: Change the background music for the whole video.

music.description: The bed under the whole video, or "asset:<id>" from upload_asset.

oneOf.title: set_music

oneOf.description: Change the film's LOOK (captions, cutting, sound cues, motion) from the next render; timing never moves.
oneOf.title: set_look

video_id.description: The video to edit. Its scene ids come from get_storyboard.

name: update_storyboard
title: Edit the scenes of a video
